results.name: actor_build_order_default
results.evidence: Zeroes a 92-byte order record via EDX, writes sentinel 0xffff and forces the CX order code to 0 when actor+6 (busy/dead flag) is set.
results.summary: Generic order-record initializer that zeroes a 92-byte actor order buffer (EDX), stores the order code from CX (or 0 if the actor at EAX is busy/dead), a 0xffff target sentinel, and the param_1 sub-code.

results.name: actor_select_formation_position
results.evidence: Looks up the actor's unit-type table (index*0xe8) then scans a squad seat/position list (stride 0x50) via FUN_00432100 depending on mode param_1 (0-5).
results.summary: Given a formation-selection mode, index and occupant filter, scans a squad's seat/position table to pick or cycle a free formation slot for the actor's unit type.

results.name: actor_pathfind_refresh_if_needed
results.evidence: Gated on actor+0x4c ('needs path'); zeroes a large scratch buffer, tags request header type 6, and calls FUN_00413e50/FUN_00414060 pathfinding request/run pair.
results.summary: If the actor needs a fresh path it issues a type-6 pathfinding request and returns whether the resulting path length (actor+0x280) is zero.

results.name: actor_get_reaction_wait_time
results.evidence: Selects among cluster search-wait fields (+0x37c/+0x388) or a combat-mode threshold (+0x608, gated by FUN_00428370) based on an implicit CX mode selector.
results.summary: Returns a float wait-time threshold chosen from cluster search-wait fields or the actor's current combat threshold depending on an implicit mode code.

results.name: actor_request_grenade_impact_trace
results.evidence: Picks a source point (cached +0x120 or looked up via FUN_00569190) and passes its offset to a target point into FUN_00505880 with request type 0x33.
results.summary: Builds a source-to-target vector for a thrown/incoming grenade and submits a type-0x33 trace request via FUN_00505880.

results.name: actor_get_command_list_search_point
results.evidence: Indexes a 100-byte-stride command-list table (DAT_008802d4) to a per-type index, then reads a float radius (+0x28) and datum handle (+0x10) from a 0x74-byte scenario record.
results.summary: Looks up the search point/radius associated with a command-list entry and packs it (with a valid/zero-radius flag) into the caller's output record via EDX.

results.name: actor_evaluate_new_destination
results.evidence: Gates on actor+0x4c ('needs destination'); issues a type-0 pathfinding request via FUN_00413e50/FUN_00414060 or, when target visible, checks distance via actor_update_target_lead_position/FUN_00412960 before falling back to combat-threshold comparisons via FUN_00428370.
results.summary: Decides whether the actor needs a new movement destination, choosing between an unseen-target pathfind request and a visible-target distance/threshold check, then defers to FUN_0041fa80 for final approval.

results.name: actor_build_order_grenade_or_melee
results.evidence: Zeroes a 24-word order buffer, sets code/target fields from parameters and in_EAX, rolls a ~40% LCG chance (random_seed_global) to force order 0x2d for codes 9..12, else calls FUN_00403f00 (pathfind) when not busy/dead.
results.summary: Builds a grenade- or melee-attack order for the actor, randomly substituting a grenade-throw code for mid-range order types before falling back to a melee pathfind check.

results.name: actor_can_perceive_last_known_target
results.evidence: Requires a valid target unit (+0x34) and last-seen slot (+0x3b8); compares squared distance to the FOV radius from FUN_00429620 and checks a relationship-type gate at (target+0x38).
results.summary: Returns whether the actor can currently perceive its last-known target position, based on field-of-view distance and target relationship type.

results.name: actor_build_pathfind_request_to_target
results.evidence: Builds a two-mode (approach/flee, header type 1 or 2) pathfinding request toward a target's relationship-object position, using its weapon marker offsets (+0xf0/+0xf4/+0xf8/+0xec) via FUN_00412880/FUN_00412ba0/FUN_00414060.
results.summary: Constructs and runs a pathfinding request toward or away from a target unit's marker position, selecting an approach or flee header depending on an implicit count, and writes back path index/success flags via unaff_EBX.

results.name: actor_evaluate_weapon_pickup_path
results.evidence: Validates a candidate weapon-holder record (unit +0x1c, seat +8), plays a pickup-related sound via FUN_00569190, and asks FUN_0042b270 whether the path to the seat marker is reachable.
results.summary: Checks whether a nearby weapon-holding unit's seat is reachable, playing a cue sound and caching the marker position on success.

results.name: actor_build_order_return_to_post
results.evidence: Zeroes a 17-dword order record then copies the actor's anchor/home position (+0x174/+0x178/+0x17c), sets order type 1 and commit flag.
results.summary: Builds an order that sends the actor back to its guard-post anchor position.

results.name: actor_build_order_guard_post
results.evidence: Zeroes a 17-word order record; branches on unaff_BX to build either an idle-in-place order or an anchor-position guard order, gated on visibility (+0x160) and busy/dead (+6) flags.
results.summary: Builds a guard-post order, either idling the actor in place or sending it back to its anchor position depending on a mode flag.

results.name: actor_build_order_search_wait
results.evidence: Bails with 0xffffff00 when morale (+0x15e)==4; otherwise builds a wait order (type 0x78) and, when a search-position handle (+0x1e8) is valid, derives a per-command-list wait multiplier via a switch on (+0x1e4 - 6).
results.summary: Builds a search/wait order for the actor, deriving its wait-time multiplier from the scenario command-list's search-behavior code.

results.name: actor_build_order_random_look
results.evidence: Picks a random look angle via random_real_range from combat (+0x29c/+0x298) or idle (+0x2d4/+0x2d0) angle ranges on the actor's unit-type table, depending on alert flag (unaff_EBX+0xc).
results.summary: Builds a look-around order that picks a random facing angle from the actor's combat or idle angle range, optionally aiming at a supplied look point.

results.name: actor_broadcast_command_list_status
results.evidence: Skips if already reported (+0xa2); maps the scenario command-list index (+0x1e4, 1..10) to a fixed chatter id (0x30..0x38) and calls ai_communication_broadcast with a target-status argument derived via FUN_0045bdb0.
results.summary: Reports the actor's current scenario command-list status once via ai_communication_broadcast, mapping the command-list index to a chatter line id.

results.name: actor_pathfind_move_and_face
results.evidence: Bails when dead/target-unseen (+6/+0x160, setting sub-order 1); otherwise, once move-request flags (+0x4c/+0xaa) are set, issues a type-4 pathfinding request via FUN_00412880/FUN_00412ba0/FUN_00414060 and stamps a randomized re-check timer (+0x9c).
results.summary: Drives the actor's movement/pathfinding sub-state machine (+0xc0), issuing a type-4 pathfind request when a move is requested and scheduling a randomized re-evaluation delay.

results.name: actor_get_relative_axis_vector
results.evidence: Selects between the actor's cached facing vector (+0x174..+0x17c) or one looked up via FUN_00569720, then switches on in_ECX+8 to return it, its negation, or a perpendicular axis via vector3d_cross_product/vector3d_normalize_with_length.
results.summary: Returns a requested axis (forward, backward, left/right) of either the actor's own facing or another object's facing vector.

results.name: actor_squad_action_reset
results.evidence: Switches on the squad action-list entry type code (from a table indexed off global_scenario+0x43c) and clears/reinitializes per-entry state, calling actor_movement_action_stop, actor_clear_vocalization and object_try_and_get depending on the case.
results.summary: Resets or clears the state associated with one entry of the current squad's action list, based on that entry's action-type code.

results.name: actor_squad_for_each_member
results.evidence: If the actor is busy/dead (+6) it walks a squad-member table (DAT_0088035c stride 0x98, DAT_00880358 stride 0x40) invoking callback param_3 for each member; otherwise it invokes the callback once for the actor itself.
results.summary: Iterates over every member of the actor's squad (or just the actor itself), optionally clearing per-member vocalization/order state, and invokes a caller-supplied callback for each.

results.name: actor_squad_notify_member_changed
results.evidence: Validates a squad member index against the current zone/cluster (DAT_0069e8d8), packs status bits from the member's type-definition flags (+0x20), and calls FUN_00407040 with a fixed callback pointer (&LAB_00406dd0).
results.summary: Notifies the actor's squad that a given member index has changed, packing its class/status flags and dispatching the update to every squad member via actor_squad_for_each_member.

results.name: actor_squad_broadcast_default
results.evidence: Thin tail-call wrapper that invokes actor_squad_for_each_member (FUN_00407040) with no explicit local arguments, relying on the caller's register state.
results.summary: Trivial wrapper around actor_squad_for_each_member that forwards the caller's register-set arguments unchanged.

results.name: actor_build_order_flee
results.evidence: Zeroes an 11-dword order record; when not blind/unaware (+0x160==0) sets flag param_1, clears the target field, and marks the actor committed (+0x98=1).
results.summary: Builds a flee order for the actor, provided it is currently aware of its surroundings.

results.name: actor_build_order_face_seat_marker
results.evidence: Zeroes an 11-dword order record and, when the actor has a live target unit (+0x34) and a valid seat index, copies that seat marker's transform (position/orientation) from the scenario object table.
results.summary: Builds an order that has the actor face a specific seat marker on its current target unit.

results.name: actor_build_order_stop
results.evidence: Zeroes an 11-dword order record and, only when the actor's not-controllable/busy flag (+6) is set, sets the order type to 2 and marks it committed.
results.summary: Builds a stop order for the actor when it is currently in a busy/uncontrollable state.

results.name: actor_build_order_wait
results.evidence: Zeroes a 13-dword order record and, when the actor is visible and alive (+0x160 and +6 both zero), sets order type 0 and stores param_1 into the following field.
results.summary: Builds a simple wait order carrying a caller-supplied sub-code, provided the actor is visible and alive.

results.name: actor_build_order_face_seat_marker_ex
results.evidence: Same seat-marker transform copy and validity gating as actor_build_order_face_seat_marker (0x407820), but additionally clears an extra flag byte and sets a 'no-commit' byte instead of marking the actor committed.
results.summary: Variant of actor_build_order_face_seat_marker that builds the seat-facing order without immediately committing the actor.

results.name: actor_pathfind_query_grenade_arc
results.evidence: Gated on actor+0x4c/+0x160/+0x9d flags; builds a type-3 pathfinding request that includes grenade-arc parameters (+0xac..+0xb8) when arc mode is active (+0xa4==1).
results.summary: Issues a type-3 pathfinding request, including grenade-arc trajectory data when the actor is in grenade-arc mode, and flags failure at +0x9e.

results.name: actor_update_investigate_state
results.evidence: Refreshes a cached investigation anchor (+0xb0..+0xb8) roughly every 0x96 ticks using object_try_and_get and actor_is_within_alert_range, then drives movement via actor_evaluate_search_position (FUN_004091d0) and actor_movement_set_destination_point, or enters a vehicle seat via unit_enter_vehicle_seat.
results.summary: Advances the actor's 'investigate a noise/last-known-position' behavior each tick, periodically re-anchoring and either moving toward or entering a vehicle seat at the investigation point.

results.name: actor_find_best_search_position
results.evidence: Iterates the cluster's candidate search-position list (count at cluster+0x2e4), scoring each via FUN_004091d0 and keeping the index/position with the highest returned score.
results.summary: Scans all candidate search positions in the actor's cluster and returns the index and data of the best-scoring one.

results.name: actor_evaluate_search_position
results.evidence: Walks a linked list of path/junction nodes (type field==9) looking for one matching the requested from/to object pair within tolerance, then scores it via distance/dot-product checks against the actor's facing.
results.summary: Evaluates a single candidate search/junction position for suitability (visibility direction, distance) and returns its score plus output position/direction/handle triples.

results.name: actor_compute_avoidance_offset
results.evidence: Computes an offset destination steering around an obstacle circle (radius/position from puVar1 fields, clamped by cluster +0x280) using perpendicular-vector math and vector2d_normalize_with_length.
results.summary: Given a straight-line destination and an obstacle, computes a deflected destination point that steers the actor around the obstacle.

results.name: actor_build_order_wait_random
results.evidence: Zeroes a 6-dword order record and, when visible (+0x160==0), stamps the current tick (DAT_006f1d6c+0xc) and a randomized wait duration (random_seed_global-derived, 300..600).
results.summary: Builds a randomized-duration wait order for the actor, timestamped with the current game tick.

results.name: actor_check_traversal_cooldown
results.evidence: Compares a traversal/jump counter (+0x308) against param_1, resets it when fleeing (mode==4) with a pending value at +0xa8, enforces a 7-tick cooldown against the last obstacle-clear tick (+0x398), and otherwise broadcasts ai_communication_broadcast(0x22,...) or defers to FUN_0040de20.
results.summary: Gates whether the actor may attempt a traversal/jump action this tick, resetting the counter and optionally broadcasting an AI event or triggering a fallback response.

results.name: actor_wants_weapon_swap_or_reload
results.evidence: Returns true when the actor's reload timers (+0x90/+0x92) are pending, or when its squad's shared low-ammo counter (looked up via DAT_008802c8/DAT_008802cc) is positive and combat duration (+0x6e) is low, or when mode==0xb with specific flags clear.
results.summary: Determines whether the actor currently wants to reload or swap weapons, based on pending reload timers, squad ammo state, or its current combat mode.

results.name: actor_unit_exit_vehicle_seat
results.evidence: Locates the actor's controlled object (object_try_and_get(3)), transforms the target seat marker with matrix4x3_multiply, repositions the biped via object_set_position_and_orientation, updates its custom animation state and light attachments, and recalculates its bounding radius.
results.summary: Handles moving the actor's controlled biped out of a vehicle seat (or into a boarding/exit animation), repositioning it at the seat marker and refreshing its render/animation state.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_reaction
results.evidence: Reacts to nearby thrown grenades (count/index at +0x3a8/+0x3ac) by calling actor_should_throw_grenade and dodge helpers FUN_0040dd50/FUN_0040de20/FUN_0040de70, and separately evaluates melee-range threat distance against +0x354.
results.summary: Per-tick check for whether the actor should react to a nearby thrown grenade (dodge or counter-throw) and, separately, whether it should initiate a melee charge based on distance to its target.

results.name: actor_evaluate_combat_orders
results.evidence: Large decision tree gated on morale/state fields (+0x6a/+0x6c/+0x6e/+0x72/+0x74/+0x160) that builds and commits one of several orders (guard post, stop, search-wait, face-seat-marker, wait, flee) via actor_set_mode, using actor_get_target_state_flags and a type-behavior table (DAT_00655258).
results.summary: Central per-tick combat-order decision routine that evaluates the actor's target/threat state and behavior-table entry, then builds and commits the appropriate order (melee, guard, search, flee, etc.) via actor_set_mode.

results.name: actor_flee_look_away
results.evidence: If in flee mode (+0x6c==4) and a look-away flag (+0xab) is set, builds a random-look order via FUN_004046c0 and commits it via actor_set_mode.
results.summary: While fleeing, has the actor look away from the threat by issuing a random-look order.

results.name: actor_should_hold_combat_status
results.evidence: If the command-list restriction (+0xa4) is active, compares morale (+0x6e) directly against param_2; otherwise requires morale above param_1 and either no active command list or a restriction flag (+0xa1).
results.summary: Decides whether the actor should remain in its current combat status rather than escalate, based on morale thresholds and scenario command-list restrictions.

results.name: actor_command_list_allows_alert
results.evidence: Looks up a per-command-type flags word from a table indexed via the target's command-list handle (DAT_008802d4/global_scenario), then checks its bits against the actor's alertness flag (+0x1f6) and combat-duration thresholds (+0x268).
results.summary: Returns whether the actor's current scenario command list permits it to enter a higher alert state given its combat duration and alertness flags.

results.name: actor_run_type_combat_behavior
results.evidence: Dispatches on the actor's behavior-type table entry (DAT_00655258 indexed by +0x6c, values 1..4) between actor_evaluate_combat_state_transition (FUN_0040c620) and actor_evaluate_combat_orders (FUN_0040cdf0), gated on morale thresholds.
results.summary: Top-level per-tick combat behavior dispatcher that routes the actor to either a state-transition evaluation or the general order-decision routine based on its behavior class and morale.

results.name: actor_maybe_run_combat_state_transition
results.evidence: Only when the actor is already in combat state 10 with a matching sub-state (+0xa0 in {2,3} needing +0xa3/+0xa4 clear, or {4,5} needing +0xc5 set) does it call actor_evaluate_combat_state_transition.
results.summary: Conditionally re-evaluates the actor's combat state transition when it is already in state 10 and its sub-state flags indicate readiness.

results.name: actor_mode_advance_secondary
results.evidence: Reads the actor's mode field (+0x6c); for modes 5/7/8 checks readiness flags (+0x9c/+0x9d) and a counter (+0xa4) before invoking per-mode helpers (FUN_0041fb00/FUN_0041fb60/FUN_0041fbc0) and falling back to actor_evaluate_combat_orders.
results.summary: Advances a secondary per-mode sub-behavior (modes 5, 7, 8) once its readiness flags are set, then re-evaluates the actor's combat orders.

results.name: actor_can_throw_grenade_at_target
results.evidence: Requires no in-flight grenade (+0x158), checks a squad-shared grenade-request cooldown via DAT_008802c8, and validates a clear throw path via FUN_00410c90/FUN_00410da0/FUN_00411180.
results.summary: Determines whether the actor is currently able to throw a grenade at its target, checking cooldowns and line-of-throw clearance.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_throw_facing
results.evidence: Uses vector2d_normalize_with_length on facing-vs-target vectors and compares the dot product against 0.8660254 (cos 30 degrees) to set the 'ready to throw' flag (+0x45c).
results.summary: Checks whether the actor is facing closely enough toward its grenade target and, if so, marks it ready to throw and stamps the squad's grenade-request timer.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_throw_desire
results.evidence: Bails if grenade projectile tag fields (+0x180/+0x182) are unset; otherwise computes a randomized throw-chance timer from tag fields (+0x1a0/+0x1a4) against game time (+0x6a4) and calls actor_can_throw_grenade_at_target.
results.summary: Periodically rolls whether the actor decides it wants to throw a grenade at its current target, based on tag-defined throw-chance parameters.

results.name: actor_flee_to_pathfind_target
results.evidence: Requires the actor to be aware (+0x160==0); clears the current threat reference (+0x270) via actor_consider_target_candidate, then when not busy (+6==0) builds a pathfind request via FUN_00403f00 and, if a path is found, commits flee mode 4 via actor_set_mode.
results.summary: Attempts to move the actor away from its current threat by pathfinding and, on success, switches it into flee mode.

results.name: actor_try_commit_melee_or_grenade_order
results.evidence: Calls FUN_00403630 (actor_build_order_grenade_or_melee) as a boolean gate and, if it succeeds, commits the order via actor_set_mode using the same (implicit) register arguments.
results.summary: Attempts to build a grenade-or-melee order for the actor and commits it via actor_set_mode if one was successfully built.

results.name: actor_can_throw_grenade_toward_threat
results.evidence: Bails if already targeting (+0x158/+0x418) or already facing the threat (FUN_00569c90); requires a valid threat record (+0x270) with a positive grenade radius (+0x234), computes a facing dot-product check, then issues order type 6 via FUN_00417a60.
results.summary: Checks whether conditions are right for the actor to throw a grenade toward its current threat, and if so queues the throw action.

results.name: actor_select_and_play_dialogue_line
results.evidence: Iterates a short array of dialogue-line indices (caller-supplied or from FUN_0056a310), skipping -1/rejected-by-FUN_00565150 lines, validates each with actor_build_order_investigate_encounter_point, then commits mode 9 via actor_set_mode and marks the line used (0xffff).
results.summary: Picks the first still-valid dialogue/investigate-point line from a list and commits an investigate-encounter-point order for it, marking the line as consumed.

results.name: actor_targets_match
results.evidence: Compares the threat descriptor pair (+0xa4, valid only in modes 5/7) of two actor indices; type 0 uses datum_get plus a random threshold (0.49), type 1 compares a handle, type 2 matches unconditionally.
results.summary: Returns whether two actors currently share the same target/threat descriptor, used to coordinate squad-mates reacting to the same threat.

results.name: actor_is_valid_grenade_candidate
results.evidence: Looks up an actor by index/salt via the standard data-array bounds/stride pattern, then checks its mode-class field (+0x37 in {2,3}) or mode (+0x36 in {5,6,7,8}) against caller flag unaff_BL, plus a team/relationship check via PTR_PTR_006853b8.
results.summary: Determines whether a given actor index is a valid target for a squad-mate's grenade throw, based on its current combat mode and team relationship.

results.name: actor_find_nearest_valid_grenade_target
results.evidence: Walks the actor's local perception list (+0x50, DAT_008802c0-indexed records) validating members via actor_is_valid_grenade_candidate and tracking the closest by squared distance (+0x11c), falling back to squad-mates via FUN_004369f0/FUN_0043ea80/FUN_0043eb30 if too few found.
results.summary: Finds the nearest valid grenade target among the actor's perceived objects (or squad-mates as a fallback) and stores its index at +0x1d0.

results.name: actor_get_mode_behavior_class
results.evidence: Indexes DAT_00655258 (the same per-mode 0x38-byte-stride behavior table used by actor_run_type_combat_behavior and actor_evaluate_combat_orders) by the actor's current mode field (+0x6c).
results.summary: Returns the behavior-class value from the per-mode property table for the actor's current combat mode.

results.name: actor_get_vocalization_table_entry
results.evidence: Bounds-checks in_CX against 0..11 and indexes a fixed 12-entry table DAT_006555a8 that parallels the mode tables used near actor_set_mode/dialogue selection.
results.summary: Looks up a fixed vocalization-table entry by an implicit CX index, returning 0 if out of range.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_avoidance
results.evidence: Maintains a state machine (+0x5f2, states 0-4) driven by grenade-type/target-validity gates (FUN_0040f670/FUN_0040f700), decrementing cooldown timers (+0x5f4/+0x5f6/+0x5f8/+0x5fc), computing a dodge offset via point3d_add_scaled/vector2d_normalize_with_length, and broadcasting ai_communication_broadcast codes 9 and 0xe for grenade danger events.
results.summary: Massive per-tick update that tracks an incoming grenade/threat class, drives a state machine deciding whether and how the actor should dodge, and broadcasts related AI communication events.

results.name: actor_grenade_type_allowed
results.evidence: Switches on a requested grenade kind (1/2/3), gating on the actor's combat mode field (+0x60c) and a combat-duration counter (+0x268), plus per-kind extra flags (+0x27c/+0x278/+0x161).
results.summary: Returns whether the actor is currently allowed to use the given grenade-throw kind, based on its combat state and per-kind conditions.

results.name: actor_grenade_target_still_valid
results.evidence: Only checks when param_1==3: looks up the current grenade-target threat record (+0x610) and returns true unless it has no weapon (+0x110==-1) and its danger score from FUN_00410da0 is 2 or less.
results.summary: For grenade-throw kind 3, checks whether the previously chosen grenade target is still a valid/dangerous-enough threat.

results.name: actor_compute_grenade_throw_point
results.evidence: For combat mode 2, derives a target weapon type from the current grenade-target record, computes an aim direction toward a stored point (+0x67c) or fixed offset, and corrects it toward a perpendicular axis via vector3d_cross_product/vector3d_build_perpendicular/vector3d_rotate_about_axis when too far off-target.
results.summary: Computes the aim direction the actor should use to throw its grenade, correcting the direction toward a perpendicular axis when it deviates too far from the desired throw angle.
